mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE up AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name, 1 AS lvl FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id, f.parent_id, f.name, up.lvl + 1 FROM files f JOIN up ON f.id = up.parent_id WHERE up.lvl < 64 ) SELECT id, name FROM up ORDER BY lvl DESC
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id FROM files f JOIN sub s ON f.parent_id = s.id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL ) UPDATE files SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub)

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id FROM files f JOIN sub s ON f.parent_id = s.id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ) UPDATE files SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id FROM files f JOIN sub s ON f.parent_id = s.id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT id, sha256, size FROM files WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub) AND is_dir = false
mapper.delete: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id FROM files f JOIN sub s ON f.parent_id = s.id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ) DELETE FROM files WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT f.id FROM files f JOIN sub s ON f.parent_id = s.id ) SELECT id, sha256, size FROM files WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub) AND is_dir = false
mapper.update: UPDATE files SET ref_count = GREATEST(0, ref_count - 1), updated_at = now() WHERE sha256 = #{sha256} AND is_dir = false AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM files WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at < #{cutoff} AND (parent_id = 0 OR parent_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM files WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY deleted_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
